verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS recruiting platform like Dover, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted, on-prem, or open-source deployment of the core product. The API, the hosted HTTP MCP server, and CSV data export are integration and portability features, not self-hosting, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
